recipes.name: Easy Coconut Cream Pie
ingredients_raw: 1 (5 ounce) package instant vanilla pudding mix
1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps.text: Whisk together milk and pudding mix in a large bowl until mixture starts to thicken, about 2 minutes. Fold in 1 cup coconut and 1/2 of the whipped topping until well combined. Pour filling into baked pie crust.
Spread remaining whipped topping over filling. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup coconut. Refrigerate pie and serve chilled.

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Coconut Cream Pie
raw_recipe.description: This coconut cream pie with pudding is topped with whipped topping and flaked coconut for a chilled dessert that tastes like it took hours to make.

review.reviewBody: I used coconut cream pudding instead of the vanilla pudding and heavy whipping cream whipped up with two tablespoons of granulated sugar instead of the coolwhip type cream. I also roasted about a half cup coconut on a preheated baking sheet to sprinkle on the top. It was great and I received lots of compliments. Too easy to be this YUMMY!!!

I did 1 tsp of coconut extract in the coconut pudding. Made my own whipped cream. Used 2 cups whipping cream, as soon as it becomes soft set add 1/4 cup of confectioners(Powdered) sugar and I add 1 1/2(one and a half) tsp of vanilla. But this time I used coconut extract in the mix. Finish mixing until firm peaks. Fold into pudding. do not use a mixer to fold. The firm peaks will help with the pie setting up firmly. Toasted coconut on top. I only got 1 slice due to friends and neighbors getting in on it. I think I did a great job for an older straight man.

This was a hit!! I usually look for recipes and improvise. This recipe was a great canvas.I cooked vanilla pudding with 15 oz Coco Lopez Cream of Coconut and part milk then added coconut shavings. Cooked and let sit.- toasted coconut- spread coconut shavings to a clean baking sheet, bake 350 to desired color. I baked for 3-5 mins. Be careful to not burn.- Crust- 1 package of graham crackers, 1/4 cup sliced almonds, 1/4 cup toasted coconut - all grinded. Add 1/4 cup of melted butter and mix until moist. Place in pie dish and pat - bake at 350 for 15 mins. Let cool. - Whipping cream - I added the remnants of Coco Lopez and a dash of coconut extract.Add pudding to pie crust chill about 1 1/2 hours - top with whipped cream and sprinkle toasted coconut. Put back in fridge until ready to serve.

I used the cooked vanilla pudding (135 g 6 serving) using 2 c milk and added tsp of coconut extract and cooled with plastic wrap over it to prevent skin (can microwave on high for approx 6 minutes, stirring every 2 min).
 Browned 1 1/2 c coconut for 5 min at 350F and added all but 1/4 c to cooled pudding with half container cool whip. Put in cooled graham wafer 9" pie shell (2 c graham crumbs, 1/3 c sugar, 1/3 c melted margarine pressed into pan and baked 8 min at 375F then cooled.). Chill for min 4 hours then top with rest of cool whip and sprinkle with rest of toasted coconut.

I’ve made this several times now and it has become a family favorite. I do use 2 packages of coconut pudding (to get the ounces) and 1 package French vanilla - I add a little milk since I’m adding a package of pudding. I also make the whipped topping instead of using cool whip and use Mexican vanilla which adds such a great flavor. I also have started making in the redi made pie crust SINGLES instead of a whole pie. Everyone seems to love having their own. Coconut cream pie can be tricky if making completely from scratch and sketchy on how it turns out - BUT THIS RECIPE- everytime is 5 stars! So easy
Added 2 teaspoons of coconut extract into the liquid measuring cup before adding the milk. Added 1/2 cup toasted coconut into the pudding mix.

Doubled this recipe for 2 pies, used 4 small boxes of cheesecake flavored instant pudding as store didn't have vanilla or coconut flavor, used 5 cups of milk total, 4 cups of coconut, only half container of cool whip mixed in, 1 cup toasted coconut for tops with a thin layer of cool whip which really let the pudding stand out. It turned out so good with the cheesecake pudding & coconut mixed I was pleasantly surprised & will do again in the future when I can't find coconut cream pudding which is what I usually prefer. This recipe is easy quick & really tasty for no bake

It was delicious. I made a graham cracker crust, substituted 1/2 cup of cream of coconut for 1/2 cup of the milk, and whipped up real whipping cream sweetened a bit with powdered sugar as opposed to Cool Whip.

This is delicious and easy to make. I used one coconut flavored pudding and one vanilla flavored, and used small store bought graham cracker crusts. This recipe fit in 12 small crusts. I also toasted some coconut in a frying pan to top off the mini pies. I brought them to poker night and my friends loved it - even the ones who claimed not to like coconut. I will make it again.

I had to really edit this recipe due to food intolerances, but I used it as a guide. I only had cook-type pudding on hand so I used that. I used a 15oz can of coconut milk (due to dairy intolerance) and used a gluten-free pie crust which I pre-baked. I toasted up a cup of shredded coconut, made the pudding, using the coconut milk and cooled it to room temperature by putting the pan in about 2 inches of cold water in the sink for about 10 minutes. Then I stirred in the toasted coconut and non-dairy topping and put it in my pie crust and put that in the fridge to set all the way. After about an hour I cut a slice and put some non-dairy topping on it and dang! Delicious! There's just me so I wait until serving to add the topping. Next time I will use the instant pudding, which sounds a lot easier.
Added 2 tsp coconut extract to milk before mixing with pudding mix. Toasted coconut for topping.
Mmmmmm BUT , I used coconut milk and more coconut flakes 😋

I've made this recipe many times. A few changes I've made: at times, I will lightly toast the coconut for the top. I always use sugar free pudding, either vanilla or cheesecake flavored, and it works fine.
Easy. Tasty. Made according to recipe. Instant vanilla pudding (store brand) called for 1 1/2 C 2% milk. Box of pudding mix is now 3 oz, not 5.
I made it with a little less milk and lightly toasted ALL the coconut flakes - it was great and there were no leftovers!
Top much jello mix for so little milk. Was like putty. Was really disappointed as it sounded so quick and easy.

While fixing several desserts, I made this pie. I used the directions on the box for pie filling which called for 2 1/2 cups of milk. I used 1 and 1/2 cups of coconut in the pudding mix. I also totally forgot to add the cool whip in with the pudding. I put cool whip on top and covered it with toasted coconut that I had put under the broiler on parchment paper. It set up fine without the cool whip. I will use this recipe again. Tasted great.
